name: Shopper Cash Rewards
_note: Closed to new applicants 2026-06-22; U.S. Bank says existing cardholders keep their cards and terms. benefits[]/earningRates[] left empty: the issuer's product page (and its footnoted list of eligible 6% retailers) is no longer published, and the only complete retailer lists found date from the 2022 launch (e.g. still include Bed Bath & Beyond). The 3% everyday menu (bills and home utilities / gas and EV charging stations / wholesale clubs) is confirmed on U.S. Bank's own rewards calculator page. Fill in once a current retailer list can be sourced, e.g. from the Guide to Benefits / cardmember agreement. Re-checked 2026-10-03: U.S. Bank's cardholder program rules (rewards.usbank.com/benefits/card/ShopperCashBenefits/program-rules) confirm quarterly enrollment in two 6% retailers + one 3% category, each capped at $1,500 in net purchases per quarter, 1.5% uncapped base, and an additional 4% on prepaid hotel/car via the Travel Center — but say the retailer list is maintained elsewhere, and the cardholder benefits page renders its lists client-side so they could not be extracted.
